sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Sessions Trial No.39/2022 is pending before the 1st ASJ, Dewas against the petitioner for the offence under Section 420 of IPC and Section 6(1) of M.P. Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam.

entities.text: M.P. Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On the same facts another Sessions Trial No.204/2019 is pending before the 1st ASJ, Ujjain.
Other co-accused is also similar in both the cases.

Under these circumstances, he prays that in the interest of justice and for convenience of the parties and witnesses, both the sessions trial be heard by a single Sessions Court and both the cases be transferred to a single Sessions Court.

3. Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the documents filed along with the petition.
4.
On perusal of the FIR in both the cases, it appears that the complainant persons and witnesses are different in both the cases and cause of action in both the cases is also not similar.
Section 177 of Cr.P.C. provides that 'every offence shall ordinarily be inquired into and tried by a Court within whose local jurisdiction it was committed'.
Therefore, trial of both the cases in their respective jurisdiction is just and proper.
Therefore, no case is made out for transfer of the case.
5. Hence, this petition under Section 407(2) of Cr.P.C. is hereby dismissed.
C.C. as per rules.
